collection,before_completion,waited_then_collected,First collection found455/500 completed; original worker left running and later finished naturally.
verification_tool,gram_eigenbasis,corrected_and_all500_recomputed,Initial audit unpacked eigh eigenvalues/eigenvectors in reversed order. Corrected audit only; no training or metric change.
scientific,all500_heads,completed_no_failed_fit,All five seeds and500 saved heads retained.
scientific,support_decision,negative_stopped,PCA8 lower AUC and worse probability errors at both budgets; no outer query scoring or post-result search.
delivery,local_calendar,corrected_registration_order,Calendar API rejected a source reference before its registration. Registered the reviewed sources and then used the existing revision-aware API successfully.
verification_tool,ui_preview_field,corrected_expected_field,UI validator initially retained the previous LieBN-specific column name; changed expectation to the actual PCA projection field and repeated the affected checks. Product and scientific values unchanged.
